formula: UpdateMask<float>(xDealNum) advances a shared remaining-lane counter initialized at 4*w, so for w=16 the predicted valid-lane masks of the four outer-loop streams are [64,0,0,0].
assumption: Extra lanes in the second x and residual UB slots which were never populated are modeled as zero; valid residual stream blocks are contiguous.
interpretation: Both hosts logged full-tensor mismatch counts only. Per-lane values and extra UB contents were not dumped and remain inferred; matching the two aggregate counts cannot establish the per-stream identity uniquely.
